description: This file defines the Query interface which declares methods related to retrieving logger data and response values within the RomRaider ECU communication module.

classes.name: Query
classes.description: An interface that specifies methods for querying logger data and response values.

methods.name: getLoggerData
methods.description: Returns logger data associated with the query.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the response value (as a double) from the query.
